name: For The Black Hour
source:
There were times of great, bright sun!

Brought by those who were afraid of uncertainty.

The night stopped and the day became suspended.

Neverending grow of the evergreen crops.

Everything under the blessings of the sun ...

How exhausting it is to always be awake...

With no sleep and no place to dream.

You need your little death!

You need the darkness that slips into your mind and shows you how to rot!

[From [url=https://strawberrynoodles.itch.io/for-the-black-hour]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
曾经有过灿烂的阳光！

由那些害怕不确定性的人带来。

黑夜停止了，白天也暂停了。

常青作物永不停歇地生长。

一切都在阳光的祝福下……

总是醒着是多么的累啊……

没有睡眠，没有地方做梦。

你需要你的小死亡！

你需要黑暗潜入你的心灵并告诉你如何腐烂！

[来自[url=https://strawberrynoodles.itch.io/for-the-black-hour]Itch.io[/url]]
